gate.note: Answered by the operator during run 1 (window, surfaces and relevance rule as recorded below).

focus: Default dossier: who this account is, what it argues, which positions and predictions it has put on record, who and what it amplifies, and which posts carry the signal.

relevance.rule: the map considers only posts with real content. Posts with no substantive content of their own (e.g. 'More of this on my timeline forever', bare reactions, emoji, one-line agreement, engagement bait) are skipped. posts.jsonl stays complete; the keep/skip decision per post is recorded in triage.jsonl and the map's counts of considered posts come from it.
relevance.endorsements: a quote whose own words only endorse or reject the quoted post ('cosigned', 'he's right', 'this', 'correct', 'wrong') is kept when the quoted post carries a forecast, claim or position; the map attributes the claim to the quoted author and records the account's endorsement or rejection.

amplification: Not decided at run 1. Reposts and replies to other accounts were not captured (the signed-in Posts tab serves originals only), so amplification is visible through quotes alone.
